text: **Hint 1:** For a white collar worker, both the managerial dummy variable ($x_m$) and the blue collar dummy variable ($x_b$) will be $$0$$. This is because the one-hot encoding for $$job_{type}$$ means that only one of the dummy variables is $$1$$ at a time, and for white collar workers, neither $x_m$ nor $x_b$ is $$1$$.\n\n**Hint 2:** Substitute the given values into the model equation. You know that $x_{edu} $$=$$ 10$, $x_m $$=$$ 0$, and $x_b $$=$$ 0$. Plug these values into the equation $\hat{y} $$=$$ $$-8$$ + 3x_{edu} + 6x_{m} - 3x_{b}$ to find the predicted wage.
